facts.value: At TurnRun animation completion, accepts facing-relative left-stick X at or above x58 and enters Run from frame0 at speed1, storing x430 in x0 and post-transition gr_vel in x4. Success suppresses the caller fallback. The caller may reverse facing in its command-driven phase; this helper tests whatever facing is current. Run Anim subtracts one only from positive x0 without clamping fractional overshoot. Late TurnRun and RunBrake checks require x0<=0.

facts.value: Selects x4 when the ground-friction multiplier is below1, otherwise gr_vel. It requests zero rate when velocity*facing<=0 and ABS(velocity)/run_animation_scaling otherwise. The setter may defer application under x2223_b0. When x0 is positive, it performs floating-point subtraction by 1 without clamping. Small fractional positive values can become negative, while large values can round unchanged; other values are unchanged. No local motion transition is issued.

If that comparison is false, including an unordered NaN value, processing returns before RunBrake; otherwise RunBrake is last. First successful action stops lower-priority checks.

facts.value: getAccelAndTarget computes acceleration from stick X*dash_accel_mul plus a signed dash_accel_base, and target from stick X*dash_max_velocity. For nonzero target and 0<gr_vel/target<1, Run multiplies acceleration by (1-ratio)*run_accel_taper_gain. It writes x4=target*x440. The target/friction helper writes xE4_ground_accel_1; ApplyGroundMovement scales that acceleration on reduced-friction ground and projects acceleration and gr_vel into animation/self velocity vectors. Neither helper directly integrates fighter position.
facts.rationale: Use canonical callee bodies and exact comparisons to correct action identity, collision enum interpretation, deferred rate effects, fractional countdown behavior and movement-preparation scope. Existing object bytes corroborate literal layout only.
